profile.name: Ahmed Egeh
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building production SaaS systems

experience.summary: Develop and maintain production SaaS systems across the core Laravel/Vue platform, Go and PHP middleware services, internal dashboards, and operational tooling. Work across backend, frontend, integrations, asynchronous processing, data pipelines, and production reliability.
highlights: Built and improved scheduling automation, including Schedule V1/V2 workflows, queue-based execution, AWS SQS dispatching, worker processing, cron/supervisor configuration, execution windows, logging, and rollout fixes.

Worked on Amazon Selling Partner API and Amazon Advertising integrations, including order/report ingestion, SKU/product data, total sales, ClickHouse insertion paths, ACOS/sales factor logic, and data quality fixes.
Delivered internal dashboard and admin tooling for client, agency, DSP, ASIN, profile, notification, scheduling, feature, and support workflows.
Improved production reliability through error handling, deployment scripts, environment configuration, logging, Sentry-related fixes, PHPStan/Rector cleanup, and production hotfixes.
Implemented frontend workflow improvements across Vue and Angular, including localization, search, pagination, loaders, forms, previews, and reporting interfaces.

experience.summary: Worked on subscription, payment, shopping cart, e-commerce integration, and data security features in a Symfony/Angular-based platform.
highlights: Developed and maintained subscription plans, payment flows, shopping cart features, and payment-link functionality.
Integrated API2Cart to synchronize external e-commerce systems with the platform.
Implemented encryption and decryption for sensitive database data using PHP/Symfony and Angular.
Added product preset functionality for Facebook Catalog and WhatsApp-based customer workflows.
Wrote and maintained unit and integration tests using PHPUnit, Jest, and Karma.
Supported production hotfixes and ongoing feature development across frontend and backend areas.

education.summary: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, graduated with Honors.
